research.name: react-force-graph
research.note: React components that render force-directed graphs in 2D canvas, 3D WebGL, VR and AR behind one shared interface.

effects: force-directed graph layout with auto-colored node clusters on a dark canvas
one component interface across 2D canvas, 3D WebGL, VR and AR renderers
DAG mode constraining the force layout into tree or radial orientations
bloom post-processing pass on the 3D graph
